text: I gave a guest lecture on multimodal learning for CS 582: ML for Bioinformatics at UIUC!
New [preprint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.04209) on how representation geometry shapes counterfactual robustness!
I gave a [lecture on multimodal learning](assets/pdf/20260219_CSCI1851_MultimodalLearning.pdf) for Brown's Machine Learning for Biology and Health course!
Our paper [“LLM-Powered Graph Reasoning for Knowledge Discovery”](https://openreview.net/forum?id=1e2KXoV3li) has been accepted to WiML @ NeurIPS 2025!
I am starting my PhD in [Computer Science](https://cs.brown.edu/) at [Brown University](https://www.brown.edu/)!
I graduated from the [Technical University of Denmark](https://www.dtu.dk/english/) with a Master's degree in Biomedical Engineering!
Our paper [“K-Paths: Reasoning over Graph Paths for Drug Repurposing and Drug Interaction Prediction”](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3711896.3737011) has been accepted to ACM KDD'25!
I will be serving as web & publication chair for [EuroSec 2025](https://eurosec-workshop.github.io)!
I am visiting [Brown CS](https://cs.brown.edu/) as a research intern. I will be working with [Ritambhara Singh](https://ritambharasingh.com/) and [Nikos Vasilakis](https://nikos.vasilak.is/).
I am joining [Radiometer Medical](https://www.radiometer.com/) as Electronics & Software Engineer!
I graduated from [University of Patras](https://www.upatras.gr/en/) with a diploma in Electrical and Computer Engineering!
